title: The Market Before the Price: What India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme Is Worth to a Cement Kiln, a Smelter and a Refinery
detail: India's carbon market is weeks from its first auction with a design aim of about US$10 a tonne; the ClimRisk engine shows how far that sits from NGFS scenario prices at three register plants.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
